{{redirect|S8|the TCG release with the set symbol S8|Fusion Strike (TCG)}} {{redirect|Pokémon Advanced Battle|the Italian opening|Pokémon Advanced Battle (song)}} {{Season Infobox |background=F77 |cellcolor=99F |name=Pokémon: Advanced Battle |image=Season8 logo.png |caption=Logo for the season |number=8 |opening=Unbeatable |numeps=52 |region=[[Hoenn]] & [[Kanto]] |series=''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]'' |prev=Pokémon: Advanced Challenge |next=Pokémon: Battle Frontier }} '''Pokémon: Advanced Battle''' is the eighth [[season]] of the [[dub]]bed version of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It is the third season of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]''. It concludes the adventures of {{Ash}}, {{an|May}}, [[Max]], and {{an|Brock}} in the [[Hoenn]] [[region]], as Ash and May compete in the [[Ever Grande Conference]] and the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]], respectively. It also begins Ash's second adventure through [[Kanto]] as he challenges the {{Gdis|Battle Frontier|III}}. It began on September 17, 2005, with the dub premiere of ''[[AG093|Clamperl of Wisdom]]'', and concluded on July 8, 2006, with ''[[AG145|Pasta La Vista]]''. It originally aired in {{pmin|the United States}} as part of the 2005-2006 {{DL|Pokémon in the United States|Kids' WB!}} Saturday morning lineup. This season [[Banned episodes|skipped]] the original [[AG101 (unaired)|AG101]] due to the {{wp|2004 Chūetsu earthquake}} as well as [[AG120]], a clip show episode. It is preceded by [[S07|Pokémon: Advanced Challenge]] and succeeded by [[S09|Pokémon: Battle Frontier]]. ==Blurb== ''Ash earns his final two Badges and secures himself a spot in the Hoenn League Championships, while May comes dangerously close to not getting her final Ribbon—setting the stage for epic showdowns with both of her rivals in the Grand Festival. Ash meets two Trainers that become his own Hoenn rivals, facing off against both of them during the course of the tournament. Upon returning to Kanto and reuniting with old friends, Ash is recruited for a new challenge—the Battle Frontier!'' ==Important events== {{spoilers}} * Teams [[Team Magma|Magma]] and [[Team Aqua|Aqua]] awaken {{p|Groudon}} and {{p|Kyogre}}, only to realize the true danger in unleashing their power. [[Lance]] helps to resolve the situation. ([[AG097]] - [[AG098]]) * {{Ash}} tries his luck against the [[Hoenn]] [[Elite Four]] member [[Drake]]. ([[AG101]]) * {{an|May}} meets a new rival [[Harley]], not knowing of his penchant for trickery. ([[AG103]]) * On the way to [[Slateport City]], Ash meets [[Morrison]], who becomes his [[rival]]. ([[AG118]]) * Ash and {{ashfr}} stop [[Brodie]], now independent, from stealing the [[Ribbon Cup]]. ([[AG119]]) * The [[Hoenn Grand Festival]] takes place. ([[AG121]] - [[AG123]]) ** May, [[Drew]], Harley, and {{ho|Robert}} get past the preliminary and main [[Appeal|Appeals Round]]. ([[AG121]] - [[AG122]]) ** May defeats Harley in the [[Contest Battle]]s, but loses to Drew, ending up in the top eight. ([[AG123]]) ** Robert defeats Drew in the finals, winning the [[Ribbon Cup]] and becoming a [[Top Coordinator]]. ([[AG123]]) * Upon arriving at [[Ever Grande City]], Ash and friends meet {{ho|Tyson}}, an [[Ever Grande Conference]] participant and torch runner. ([[AG125]]) * The Ever Grande Conference takes place ([[AG126]] - [[AG131]]) ** Ash, Morrison, and Tyson make it past the preliminary round. ([[AG126]]) ** Ash, Morrison, and Tyson make it through the qualifying rounds. ([[AG127]] - [[AG128]]) ** Ash battles {{ho|Katie}} and wins. ([[AG128]] - [[AG129]]) ** Ash battles Morrison and wins. ([[AG129]] - [[AG130]]) ** Ash battles Tyson, and loses. Ash comes in the top eight in the [[Hoenn League]], while Tyson becomes the Ever Grande Conference winner. ([[AG130]] - [[AG131]]) * Ash and his friends part ways. Ash later meets [[Scott]] and [[Agatha]] at the [[Viridian Gym]]. Scott tells Ash of the {{Gdis|Battle Frontier|III}}. ([[AG132]]) * Ash, May and [[Max]] reunite at {{an|Professor Oak}}'s {{TP|Professor Oak|Laboratory}}, and {{an|Brock}} rejoins the group in the very end of the episode. ([[AG133]]) * {{an|Misty}} makes an appearance for three episodes. ([[AG132]] - [[AG134]]) * Ash and May begin their quests to participate in the Battle Frontier and Kanto {{pkmn|Contest}}s, respectively. ==Trivia== * For reasons unknown, this season was never aired on {{pmin|New Zealand}} television. However DVDs were made available, which at the time was unusual for recent season in New Zealand. It was also aired on the {{pmin|Australia}}n {{wp|Cartoon Network (Australia)|Cartoon Network}}, which can be viewed in New Zealand through {{wp|Sky Network Television|Sky}}. * The episodes of this season, [[S06|Pokémon: Advanced]], and [[S07|Pokémon: Advanced Challenge]] for sale on [[iTunes]] are missing the [[Who's That Pokémon?]] and [[Pokémon Trainer's Choice]] segments, as well as the season-based eyecatches from the final commercial breaks. * This is the final season to air on Kids' WB! ** This is also the final season dubbed by [[4Kids Entertainment]]. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=9999FF|bordercolor=FF7777 |cs={{tt|Pokémon Pokračujem: Finální zápas|Pokémon Advanced: The Final Match}}{{tt|*|English version with Czech subtitles}} |da=Pokémon: Advanced Battle |nl=Pokémon: Advanced Battle |fi=Pokémon: Advanced Battle |fr={{tt|Pokémon: Ultime Combat|Pokémon: Advanced Battle}} |de=Pokémon: Advanced Battle |hi=पोकेमोन: एडवांस्ड बैटल |ta=பொகெமொன்: அட்வான்ஸ்ட் பாட்டிலே |te=పోకీమాన్: అడ్వాన్స్డ్ బాటిల్లె |it=Pokémon: Advanced Battle |pt_br={{tt|Pokémon: Batalha Avançada|Pokémon: Advanced Battle}}
